title: Quantum Algorithms for Modulated Circulant Matrix Vector Multiplication
summary: Modulated circulant matrices form a special class of N-parametric circulant matrices, recently introduced in the literature, with a structured spectral decomposition based on a Vandermonde type basis. Motivated by this definition, in this work we define the Modulated Quantum Fourier Transform (MQFT), a quantum primitive tailored to this matrix family.
